metadata.source_package_note: Packet 006 is the controlling source. F6.md was explicitly not used as authority because it states Family 6 was unspecified.
metadata.source_salvage_note: F10.md was used only as salvage context for disco/nu-disco boundary notes in archetype 040, and F7.md was used only as salvage context for modern/alternative R&B boundary notes in archetype 044. Rows not explicitly named in Packet 006 remain existing_seed=false.

normalization.source_rows_existing_seed: Only artist objects explicitly named in Packet 006 are marked existing_seed=true.
normalization.version_policy: Distinct live, soundtrack, compilation, solo/group, collaboration, and era-specific rows are preserved as separate objects where the survey signal differs.
